name: run-status-lifecycle-transition
reason: Workflow Run status progression (accepted->queued->running, active->blocked) must go through the validated lifecycle machine, not ad-hoc status writes (NIN-109/197).

name: run-status-inbound-parse
reason: Inbound external status strings must be parsed into a Run Status so a Workflow State value is never accepted as a Run Status (NIN-109/197/270).

name: evidence-show
reason: `run evidence show <id>` reads evidence through readEvidenceForDisplay, redacting secret-classified fields on display while preserving the raw stored record (NIN-108/204).
